title: US Civil Rights Leader Martin Luther King, Jr.
titleZh: 美国民权领袖马丁·路德·金
credits: Dorothy Gundy wrote this story for VOA Learning English. Kelly Jean Kelly was the editor.

sentences.en: Martin Luther King, Jr. was an American leader of the civil rights movement in the 1960s.
sentences.zh: 马丁·路德·金是20世纪60年代美国民权运动的领袖。

sentences.en: King is remembered for his non-violent protests against the unequal treatment of African-Americans.
sentences.zh: 人们铭记他反对非裔美国人受到不平等待遇的和平抗议。

sentences.en: His actions led to equal rights laws for all people.
sentences.zh: 他的行动促成了赋予所有人平等权利的法律。

sentences.en: In addition to being an activist, King was a scholar and religious leader – a pastor in the Christian Baptist church.
sentences.zh: 除了是社会活动家之外，金还是一位学者和宗教领袖——基督教浸信会的一名牧师。

sentences.en: One of the most famous events related to him came in 1963.
sentences.zh: 与他有关的最著名事件之一发生在1963年。

sentences.en: That year, more the 250,000 people gathered in Washington, D.C. for the “March on Washington.”
sentences.zh: 那一年，超过25万人聚集在华盛顿特区，参加“华盛顿大游行”。

sentences.en: King spoke to them on the steps of President Abraham Lincoln’s memorial.
sentences.zh: 马丁·路德·金在亚伯拉罕·林肯纪念堂的台阶上向他们发表演讲。

sentences.en: He delivered a historic address known as the “I Have a Dream” speech.
sentences.zh: 他发表了一场被誉为“我有一个梦想”演讲的历史性讲话。

sentences.en: One of the most famous lines from the speech reads: “I have a dream that…one day … little black boys and black girls will be able to join hands with little white boys and white girls as sisters and brothers.”
sentences.zh: 这场演讲中最著名的几句之一是：“我有一个梦想……有一天……小黑男孩和小黑女孩能够与小白男孩和小白女孩像兄弟姐妹一样手牵手。”

sentences.en: King’s actions helped pass the Civil Rights Act of 1964.
sentences.zh: 金的行动帮助通过了1964年的《民权法》。

sentences.en: The law ended the legal separation of people by race in public places.
sentences.zh: 这部法律结束了公共场所按种族对人们进行的合法隔离。

sentences.en: The act also banned job discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion or national origin.
sentences.zh: 该法案还禁止基于种族、肤色、宗教或原籍的就业歧视。

sentences.en: King and other activists watched the president sign the law.
sentences.zh: 金和其他活动人士观看了总统签署这部法律。

sentences.en: ​The Civil Rights Act was important, but it did not address all kinds of racial discrimination.
sentences.zh: 《民权法》很重要，但它并未解决所有种类的种族歧视问题。

sentences.en: For example, black Americans still did not have the same voting rights as white Americans, especially in southern states.
sentences.zh: 例如，黑人美国人仍然没有与白人美国人相同的选举权，尤其是在南方各州。

sentences.en: So, in March of 1965, a group of activists in Alabama marched in protest of unequal voting practices.
sentences.zh: 因此，在1965年3月，阿拉巴马州的一群活动人士举行游行，抗议不平等的选举做法。

sentences.en: State police attacked the protesters.
sentences.zh: 州警察袭击了抗议者。

sentences.en: Some wanted to answer with violence, but King urged peaceful action instead.
sentences.zh: 有些人想用暴力回应，但力劝和平行动。

sentences.en: The events in Alabama pushed Congress to pass the Voting Rights Act.
sentences.zh: 阿拉巴马发生的事件促使国会通过了《选举权法》。

sentences.en: It was signed into law by President Lyndon Johnson in August of 1965.
sentences.zh: 这部法律由林登·约翰逊总统于1965年8月签署成为法律。

sentences.en: In the following years, King worked for economic equality.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几年里，马丁·路德·金为经济平等而奋斗。

sentences.en: In April 1968, he was attending a workers’ strike in Tennessee.
sentences.zh: 1968年4月，他参加了田纳西州的一场工人罢工。

sentences.en: While he was standing outside his hotel room, a sniper shot him in the face.
sentences.zh: 当他站在酒店房间外面时，一名狙击手朝他的面部开火。

sentences.en: King soon died of his wounds.
sentences.zh: 金很快因伤去世。

sentences.en: ​The shooter was identified as a criminal who had escaped from jail.
sentences.zh: 凶手被确认为一名从监狱逃出的罪犯。

sentences.en: James Earl Ray was a white man who said he hated King.
sentences.zh: 詹姆斯·厄尔·雷是一名白人，他表示自己憎恨金。

sentences.en: Ray was found guilty and sent to prison.
sentences.zh: 雷被判有罪并被送进监狱。

sentences.en: King is remembered for many things, including his focus on nonviolent action to achieve social and political change.
sentences.zh: 金因诸多事迹而被人们铭记，其中包括他致力于以非暴力手段实现社会和政治变革。

sentences.en: In 1986, the U.S. government observed the first Martin Luther King Day.
sentences.zh: 1986年，美国政府首次纪念马丁·路德·金纪念日。

sentences.en: Many Americans have the day off school and work.
sentences.zh: 许多美国人这天放假，不用上学和上班。

sentences.en: They are urged to use the time to volunteer in their communities.
sentences.zh: 人们被呼吁利用这段时间在社区从事志愿服务。

sentences.en: Martin Luther King, Jr.’s life and achievements are also honored at a memorial.
sentences.zh: 马丁·路德·金 Jr. 的生平与成就也在一座纪念堂中得到纪念。

sentences.en: It was dedicated in Washington, D.C. in 2011.
sentences.zh: 该纪念堂于2011年在华盛顿哥伦比亚特区落成启用。
